verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports this story. Bases is a core plugin that creates database-like views of notes, Notion databases convert into Bases, and a community user calls Bases a faster replacement for Dataview's queries-to-tables. Together these imply note metadata can be queried for retrieval, but nothing explicitly documents typed properties or tags. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of typed note properties, any evidence of tag support, consistent property types across the vault, and hands-on corroboration of property- or tag-based search and filtering.
